blocks.zh: 本節總覽

blocks.zh: TR1第3節是整份報告的科學核心，提供滅菌循環所需的定量工具。掌握這些工具，才能設計有科學依據的滅菌程序，並在確效研究中做出正確判斷。
blocks.en: Section 3 of TR1 is the scientific core of the whole report and provides the quantitative tools needed for sterilization cycles. Only by mastering these tools can you design a scientifically justified sterilization process and make sound judgments in validation studies.

blocks.zh: 本節涵蓋三大核心主題：
blocks.en: This section covers three core topics:

blocks.en: Sterilization models (3.1): microbial death kinetics and their mathematical description

blocks.zh: Sterilization Models | 滅菌模型
blocks.en: Sterilization Models

blocks.zh: Semilogarithmic first-order kinetics of microbial death | 微生物死亡的半對數一階動力學
blocks.en: Semilogarithmic first-order kinetics of microbial death

blocks.zh: 核心概念：一階動力學
blocks.en: Core Concept: First-Order Kinetics

blocks.zh: 微生物在恆定熱應力下的死亡遵循一階動力學——每單位時間死亡的比例是固定的，與現存數量無關。這就像放射性衰變：不論初始數量多少，每個D值時間段都消滅90%的存活微生物。
blocks.en: Microbial death under constant heat stress follows first-order kinetics: the fraction killed per unit time is constant, regardless of how many organisms remain. It is like radioactive decay: whatever the starting population, each D-value interval of time destroys 90% of the surviving microorganisms.

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：銀行利息的反面
blocks.en: Everyday Analogy: Bank Interest in Reverse

blocks.zh: 想像一個銀行帳戶，每分鐘損失90%的餘額（而非增加）。無論你從100萬還是1元開始，比例損失都相同。這就是半對數模型的直覺——在對數尺度上是直線。
blocks.en: Imagine a bank account that loses 90% of its balance every minute (instead of gaining interest). Whether you start with one million or with 1, the proportional loss is the same. That is the intuition behind the semilogarithmic model: on a logarithmic scale it is a straight line.

blocks.zh: 因此，圖3.1-1的x軸（時間）與y軸（log存活數）之間呈直線關係，斜率的倒數就是D值。
blocks.en: This is why, in Figure 3.1-1, time (x-axis) and log survivors (y-axis) form a straight line, and the negative reciprocal of the slope is the D-value.

blocks.zh: 方程式解讀
blocks.en: Interpreting the Equation

blocks.zh: 實際操作含義：
blocks.en: What this means in practice:

blocks.zh: 若 N<sub>0</sub> = 10<sup>6</sup>，D<sub>T</sub> = 2.5 min，暴露 F = 30 min
blocks.en: If N<sub>0</sub> = 10<sup>6</sup>, D<sub>T</sub> = 2.5 min, and the exposure F = 30 min

blocks.zh: N<sub>F</sub> = 10<sup>−6</sup>（百萬分之一存活機率）
blocks.en: N<sub>F</sub> = 10<sup>−6</sup> (a one-in-a-million probability of survival)

blocks.zh: 這個「百萬分之一」概念正是 SAL（無菌保證水準） 10−6 的科學基礎。
blocks.en: This "one in a million" concept is the scientific basis of an SAL (sterility assurance level) of 10−6.

blocks.zh: 模型的局限性
blocks.en: Limitations of the Model

blocks.zh: PDA TR1 誠實指出：半對數模型並不完美地符合所有實驗數據，但目前沒有更好的替代模型。一個實用模型的三個要求：
blocks.en: PDA TR1 is candid that the semilogarithmic model does not fit all experimental data perfectly, but no better alternative is currently available. A practical model must meet three requirements:

blocks.zh: 能描述系統行為
blocks.en: It can describe the behavior of the system

blocks.zh: 能預測系統表現
blocks.en: It can predict the performance of the system

blocks.zh: 合理易用易懂
blocks.en: It is reasonable, easy to use and easy to understand

blocks.zh: 工業界接受這個模型的原因是其保守性——在多數情況下，實際殺菌效果優於模型預測。
blocks.en: Industry accepts this model because of its conservatism: in most cases, the actual kill achieved is better than the model predicts.

blocks.zh: Resistance Value (D<sub>T</sub>) | D值（熱阻力值）
blocks.en: Resistance Value (D<sub>T</sub>)

blocks.zh: Time for one-log reduction of microbial population | 微生物族群減少一個對數所需時間
blocks.en: Time for one-log reduction of microbial population

blocks.zh: D值視覺化解說
blocks.en: Visualizing the D-value

blocks.zh: D值是存活曲線在半對數圖上水平軸方向前進一個對數單位所需的時間：
blocks.en: The D-value is the time required for the survival curve to advance one logarithmic unit along the horizontal axis of a semilogarithmic plot:

blocks.zh: 若 D121°C = 2.5 min，則達到 SAL 10−6 需要 12 × 2.5 = 30 分鐘。
blocks.en: If D121°C = 2.5 min, then reaching an SAL of 10−6 requires 12 × 2.5 = 30 minutes.

blocks.zh: D值的生物學意義
blocks.en: Biological Meaning of the D-value

blocks.zh: D值不是微生物的基因固定特徵，而是微生物與環境的互動結果。同一株嗜熱脂肪土芽孢桿菌（Geobacillus stearothermophilus）在不同培養基、不同濕度、不同pH條件下，D值可能相差數倍。
blocks.en: The D-value is not a fixed genetic characteristic of an organism; it is the result of the interaction between the organism and its environment. The same strain of Geobacillus stearothermophilus can show D-values that differ several-fold depending on the culture medium, humidity and pH.

blocks.zh: 這也是為什麼生物指示劑的規格需嚴格控制：同一批次、同一製備方式，才能保證D值的一致性。
blocks.en: This is why the specification of biological indicators must be tightly controlled: only the same lot, prepared in the same way, can ensure a consistent D-value.

blocks.zh: 重要限制：生產滅菌器不適用Fraction-Negative法
blocks.en: Important Limitation: The Fraction-Negative Method Is Not Applicable in Production Sterilizers

blocks.zh: 在生產用滅菌器中放置多個BI，這些BI不是複本（replicates），因為滅菌器不同位置的致死量不一定相同。Fraction-Negative法的前提是每個BI受到完全相同的熱暴露，這在生產滅菌器中無法保證。
blocks.en: When multiple BIs are placed in a production sterilizer, these BIs are not replicates, because the lethality delivered at different locations in the sterilizer is not necessarily the same. The fraction-negative method assumes that every BI receives exactly the same heat exposure, which cannot be guaranteed in a production sterilizer.

blocks.zh: Temperature Coefficient (z-value) | 溫度係數（z值）
blocks.en: Temperature Coefficient (z-value)

blocks.zh: Degrees of temperature change needed to alter D-value by a factor of 10 | D值改變10倍所需的溫度變化度數
blocks.en: Degrees of temperature change needed to alter D-value by a factor of 10

blocks.zh: z值：熱阻力的溫度敏感性
blocks.en: z-value: Temperature Sensitivity of Heat Resistance

blocks.zh: z值描述微生物熱阻力隨溫度的變化速率。z值越小，意味著溫度對D值的影響越大（對溫度更敏感）；z值越大，微生物的熱阻力對溫度變化較不敏感。
blocks.en: The z-value describes how quickly microbial heat resistance changes with temperature. A smaller z-value means temperature has a greater effect on the D-value (greater sensitivity to temperature); a larger z-value means the heat resistance of the organism is less sensitive to temperature changes.

blocks.zh: 標準值：濕熱滅菌常規使用 z = 10°C（對應嗜熱脂肪土芽孢桿菌）
blocks.en: Standard value: moist heat sterilization routinely uses z = 10°C (corresponding to Geobacillus stearothermophilus)

blocks.zh: 比喻：z值像音量旋鈕的靈敏度
blocks.en: Analogy: The z-value Is Like the Sensitivity of a Volume Knob

blocks.zh: 想像兩個音響：一個旋鈕轉10度音量變10倍（z=10），另一個轉8度就變10倍（z=8）。z值小的那個「更靈敏」——小小的溫度變化就大幅改變殺菌效果。
blocks.en: Imagine two stereos: on one, turning the knob 10 degrees changes the volume tenfold (z = 10); on the other, turning it only 8 degrees does the same (z = 8). The one with the smaller z-value is "more sensitive": a small change in temperature greatly changes the sterilization effect.

blocks.zh: 這解釋了為什麼在F值計算中必須正確使用z值：如果BI的z值是8°C但你用10°C計算，物理F值與生物F值就會不一致。
blocks.en: This explains why the z-value must be used correctly in F-value calculations: if the z-value of the BI is 8°C but you calculate with 10°C, the physical F-value and the biological F-value will not agree.

blocks.zh: z值數值範例
blocks.en: Numerical Example of the z-value

blocks.zh: 以 z = 8°C，D<sub>112°C</sub> = 1.6 min 為例：
blocks.en: Taking z = 8°C and D<sub>112°C</sub> = 1.6 min as an example:

blocks.zh: 實際確效工作中，若採用產品特定方法，必須使用實際測定的BI z值（而非預設的10°C）來計算物理F值，以確保物理與生物F值的一致性。
blocks.en: In actual validation work, when a product-specific approach is used, the measured z-value of the BI (rather than the default 10°C) must be used to calculate the physical F-value, to ensure that the physical and biological F-values are consistent.

blocks.zh: 熱阻力曲線（Thermal Resistance Curve）
blocks.en: Thermal Resistance Curve

blocks.zh: 在半對數圖上（y軸：log D值，x軸：溫度），D值對溫度的關係為一條直線，稱為熱阻力曲線。
blocks.en: On a semilogarithmic plot (y-axis: log D-value; x-axis: temperature), the relationship between D-value and temperature is a straight line, called the thermal resistance curve.

blocks.zh: 斜率的絕對值倒數 = z值
blocks.en: The reciprocal of the absolute value of the slope = z-value

blocks.zh: 此曲線可外推到不同溫度下的D值
blocks.en: This curve can be extrapolated to D-values at other temperatures

blocks.zh: 非濕熱滅菌溫度範圍的外推不可靠
blocks.en: Extrapolation outside the moist heat sterilization temperature range is unreliable

blocks.zh: Lethal Rate (L) and Lethality (F) | 致死率與致死性
blocks.en: Lethal Rate (L) and Lethality (F)

blocks.zh: Integration of time-temperature data to quantify sterilization efficacy | 整合時間-溫度數據以量化滅菌效力
blocks.en: Integration of time-temperature data to quantify sterilization efficacy

blocks.zh: F<sub>0</sub> vs F<sub>BIO</sub>：物理與生物致死性
blocks.en: F<sub>0</sub> vs F<sub>BIO</sub>: Physical and Biological Lethality

blocks.zh: 確效研究中，F<sub>0</sub> 與 F<sub>BIO</sub> 應一致——若差距過大，需調查z值設定或BI系統問題。
blocks.en: In validation studies, F<sub>0</sub> and F<sub>BIO</sub> should agree; if the difference is too large, the z-value setting or the BI system must be investigated.

blocks.zh: F<sub>0</sub>的實際意義
blocks.en: Practical Meaning of F<sub>0</sub>

blocks.zh: F0 = 8 min 代表：無論實際的升溫曲線、保溫溫度、降溫速率如何，這個製程對微生物的殺傷力，等同於在121°C 維持精確 8 分鐘。
blocks.en: F0 = 8 min means that, regardless of the actual heat-up profile, hold temperature and cool-down rate, the microbial kill delivered by this process is equivalent to exactly 8 minutes at 121°C.

blocks.zh: 這個概念讓工廠可以用不同設備、不同配方的製程，只要F<sub>0</sub>達標，就能確保相同的滅菌保證水準。這是整個濕熱滅菌確效體系的基石。
blocks.en: This concept allows a facility to use different equipment and different formulations: as long as the F<sub>0</sub> target is met, the same sterility assurance level is ensured. This is the cornerstone of the entire moist heat sterilization validation framework.

blocks.zh: 致死率 L 的直覺理解
blocks.en: Intuitive Understanding of the Lethal Rate L

blocks.zh: L值是「當下這一分鐘等於在121°C下的幾分鐘」。L值範圍：
blocks.en: The L value tells you how many minutes at 121°C the current minute is equivalent to. The range of L values:

blocks.zh: 這解釋了為什麼升溫階段和降溫初期對F值有貢獻——即使低於設定溫度，仍有累積致死效果。
blocks.en: This explains why the heat-up phase and the early cool-down phase contribute to the F-value: even below the set temperature, lethality still accumulates.

blocks.en: F-value Calculation: Time-Temperature Integration

blocks.zh: 實際計算範例（來自TR1 Table 3.1.3.2-1）：

blocks.en: Conclusion: the equivalent lethal time of this process at 121°C = F0 = 5.038 minutes

blocks.en: Comparison

blocks.en: Overkill vs. Bioburden-Based Approach

blocks.zh: SAL 10<sup>−6</sup> 的含義
blocks.en: Meaning of an SAL of 10<sup>−6</sup>

blocks.zh: SAL（無菌保證水準）= 10<sup>−6</sup> 意指：在符合規範的滅菌製程後，任何一個單位產品為非無菌的機率不超過百萬分之一。
blocks.en: SAL (sterility assurance level) = 10<sup>−6</sup> means that, after a compliant sterilization process, the probability that any single unit of product is non-sterile is no more than one in a million.

blocks.zh: 注意：SAL 10−6 不代表每百萬個產品中有一個有菌——它是機率概念，不是頻率概念。這個數值本身無法直接測試驗證，只能通過正確設計和確效的製程來保證。
blocks.en: Note: an SAL of 10−6 does not mean that one in every million products is contaminated; it is a probability concept, not a frequency concept. The value itself cannot be verified directly by testing and can only be assured through a properly designed and validated process.

blocks.zh: Practice Questions | 練習思考題
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: Test your understanding of sterilization science concepts | 測試你對滅菌科學概念的理解
blocks.en: Test your understanding of sterilization science concepts

blocks.zh: Question 1 | 問題一
blocks.en: Question 1

blocks.zh: 一個生物指示劑的 D<sub>121°C</sub> = 1.8 分鐘，初始孢子數 = 10<sup>6</sup>。若滅菌製程提供 F<sub>0</sub> = 15 分鐘，存活機率（N<sub>F</sub>）為何？
blocks.en: A biological indicator has D<sub>121°C</sub> = 1.8 minutes and an initial spore count of 10<sup>6</sup>. If the sterilization process delivers F<sub>0</sub> = 15 minutes, what is the survival probability (N<sub>F</sub>)?

blocks.zh: Show Answer | 查看答案
blocks.en: Show Answer

blocks.zh: 結論：約 0.47% 的機率有一個存活微生物，或每 213 個BI中預期有一個陽性。這遠優於 SAL 10−6，屬於 Overkill 方法範疇。
blocks.en: Conclusion: there is about a 0.47% probability of one surviving organism, or one positive is expected in every 213 BIs. This is far better than an SAL of 10−6 and falls within the overkill approach.

blocks.zh: Question 2 | 問題二
blocks.en: Question 2

blocks.zh: 滅菌器設定 121°C，但實際產品溫度在曝露階段在 120–122°C 之間波動（z = 10°C）。在 120°C 一分鐘 vs. 在 122°C 一分鐘，各對 F<sub>0</sub> 貢獻多少？
blocks.en: The sterilizer is set to 121°C, but the actual product temperature fluctuates between 120 and 122°C during the exposure phase (z = 10°C). How much does one minute at 120°C vs. one minute at 122°C each contribute to F<sub>0</sub>?

blocks.zh: 結論：122°C 的貢獻（1.259）比 120°C（0.794）高出約 58%。這說明溫度偏差對 F 值計算有顯著影響，即使只差 2°C。確保製程溫度均勻性對準確的 F 值計算至關重要。
blocks.en: Conclusion: the contribution at 122°C (1.259) is about 58% higher than at 120°C (0.794). This shows that temperature deviations have a significant effect on the F-value calculation, even when they are only 2°C. Ensuring process temperature uniformity is critical to an accurate F-value calculation.

blocks.zh: Question 3 | 問題三
blocks.en: Question 3

blocks.zh: 你正在設計生物負載法的滅菌製程。每容器平均生物負載 = 100 CFU，最耐熱菌的 D<sub>121°C</sub> = 0.5 分鐘。要達到 SAL 10<sup>−6</sup>，最低 F<sub>0</sub> 為多少？
blocks.en: You are designing a sterilization process using the bioburden-based approach. The average bioburden per container = 100 CFU, and the D<sub>121°C</sub> of the most heat-resistant organism = 0.5 minutes. What is the minimum F<sub>0</sub> required to achieve an SAL of 10<sup>−6</sup>?

blocks.zh: 目標：N<sub>F</sub> ≤ 10<sup>−6</sup>
blocks.en: Target: N<sub>F</sub> ≤ 10<sup>−6</sup>

blocks.zh: 結論：F0 ≥ 4.0 分鐘即可達到 SAL 10−6。這比 Overkill 法所需的 F0 ≥ 12 分鐘寬鬆許多，適合熱敏感產品——但必須嚴格維持生物負載監控計畫，確保生物負載不超過設計假設。
blocks.en: Conclusion: F0 ≥ 4.0 minutes is enough to achieve an SAL of 10−6. This is much less demanding than the F0 ≥ 12 minutes required by the overkill approach and is suitable for heat-sensitive products, but the bioburden monitoring program must be strictly maintained to ensure that bioburden does not exceed the design assumption.

blocks.zh: Question 4 | 問題四
blocks.en: Question 4

blocks.zh: 為什麼不能使用 Fraction-Negative 法，對放置在生產滅菌器不同位置的 BI 進行 D 值測定？
blocks.en: Why can the fraction-negative method not be used to determine the D-value of BIs placed at different locations in a production sterilizer?

blocks.zh: Fraction-Negative 法的前提假設是所有 BI 受到相同劑量的致死因子（uniform lethality）。在實驗室用 resistometer 測定時，這個條件可以滿足。
blocks.en: The fraction-negative method assumes that all BIs receive the same dose of the lethal agent (uniform lethality). This condition can be met when testing in the laboratory with a resistometer.

blocks.zh: 但在生產滅菌器中，不同位置（冷點、熱點、負載中心 vs. 邊緣）可能受到不同的 F 值。放置在不同位置的 BI 並非「複本（replicates）」，而是在不同條件下測試的樣本。
blocks.en: In a production sterilizer, however, different locations (cold spot, hot spot, load center vs. periphery) may receive different F-values. BIs placed at different locations are not "replicates"; they are samples tested under different conditions.

blocks.zh: 結論：若對這些數據套用 Fraction-Negative 統計方法，計算出的 D 值將是無意義的混合結果，不代表任何真實的微生物熱阻力。這類數據只能用於判斷特定位置是否滿足殺菌條件，而非計算 D 值。
blocks.en: Conclusion: if fraction-negative statistics are applied to such data, the calculated D-value will be a meaningless composite that does not represent any true microbial heat resistance. Such data can only be used to judge whether a particular location meets the sterilization conditions, not to calculate a D-value.
